details: Crypto markets are experiencing pressure due to ongoing macroeconomic uncertainty, specifically concerns around inflation and the potential for a more restrictive Federal Reserve policy. The upcoming October Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) report and third-quarter GDP figures, both scheduled for November 25, are closely watched as they could influence the Fed's interest rate decisions. Higher-than-expected inflation could reinforce expectations for tighter monetary policy, potentially putting downward pressure on Bitcoin and altcoins.
title: US Inflation & Hawkish Fed Weigh on Crypto

details: Following recent selling pressure, the crypto market is showing signs of recovery. Bitcoin (BTC) is currently trading in the $59,000–$60,000 range after briefly touching a low of around $55,000 on November 21. Ethereum (ETH) is also in recovery mode, trading within the $1,600–$1,700 zone. However, the market remains highly volatile, with some companies like BTCS reducing leverage by selling ETH in response to the sharp sell-off in equity and digital asset markets.
title: Crypto Market Shows Signs of Recovery After Recent Sell-Off

details: MSCI will remove a company named "Strategy" from its key indexes by November 30, 2026. This reclassification as a "non-operating issuer" is due to the company's substantial Bitcoin holdings. This move is expected to trigger index-tracking funds to sell approximately $1.5 billion to $2.8 billion worth of shares, potentially impacting the stock price and highlighting the increasing scrutiny of crypto-related corporate strategies in traditional finance.
title: MSCI to Remove 'Strategy' from Indexes Over Bitcoin Holdings

details: Gold and silver prices have significantly plunged since their January 2026 peaks, losing a combined $15 trillion in market value. Gold dropped nearly 37%, and silver fell approximately 65%. In contrast, Bitcoin also declined but less severely, falling about 32% from its high of $81,000 to $55,000. This indicates Bitcoin's relative strength amidst the broader turmoil in traditional safe-haven assets.
title: Gold and Silver Lose Trillions; Bitcoin Shows Relative Strength

details: Bitmine Immersion Technologies, Inc. (BMNR) reported substantial crypto, cash, marketable securities, and "moonshot" holdings totaling $11.1 billion as of November 22, 2026. This includes over 6 million ETH, with 5,227,037 ETH valued at $9 billion actively staked. This demonstrates continued institutional engagement and investment in Ethereum staking and the broader digital asset space.
title: Bitmine Holds $11.1B in Crypto, Stakes Over 5M ETH
